import json
import pathlib
import statistics

root = pathlib.Path('docs/results')
load = lambda name: json.loads((root / name).read_text())
event = lambda payload, name: next(
    item for item in payload['top_events']
    if item['name'] == name and item['self_device_time_us'] > 0
)
optional = lambda payload, name: next(
    (
        item for item in payload['top_events']
        if item['name'] == name and item['self_device_time_us'] > 0
    ),
    None,
)
profile_pairs = {
    'row5': (
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c10-baseline-row05-profile.json'),
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row05-profile.json'),
    ),
    'row6': (
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c7-baseline-row06-profile.json'),
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row06-profile.json'),
    ),
    'row8': (
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c6-baseline-row08-profile-c.json'),
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row08-profile.json'),
    ),
    'row11': (
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c8-baseline-row11-profile-e.json'),
        load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row11-profile.json'),
    ),
}
profiles = {}
for name, (baseline, current) in profile_pairs.items():
    if name == 'row8':
        before = event(baseline, 'aten::addmm')
        after = event(current, 'aten::addmm')
        profiles[name] = {
            'addmm_count': [before['count'], after['count']],
            'addmm_us': [before['self_device_time_us'], after['self_device_time_us']],
            'addmm_delta_pct': 100 * (after['self_device_time_us'] / before['self_device_time_us'] - 1),
            'model_us': [
                event(baseline, 'optimized_transformer')['self_device_time_us'],
                event(current, 'optimized_transformer')['self_device_time_us'],
            ],
        }
        profiles[name]['model_delta_pct'] = 100 * (
            profiles[name]['model_us'][1] / profiles[name]['model_us'][0] - 1
        )
        continue
    before_add = event(baseline, 'aten::add')
    before_norm = event(baseline, 'aten::native_layer_norm')
    after_fused = event(current, '_residual_layer_norm_fwd')
    after_norm = event(current, 'aten::native_layer_norm')
    before_subsystem = before_add['self_device_time_us'] + before_norm['self_device_time_us']
    after_subsystem = after_fused['self_device_time_us'] + after_norm['self_device_time_us']
    profiles[name] = {
        'counts': {
            'before_add': before_add['count'],
            'before_native': before_norm['count'],
            'after_fused': after_fused['count'],
            'after_native': after_norm['count'],
        },
        'subsystem_us': [before_subsystem, after_subsystem],
        'subsystem_delta_pct': 100 * (after_subsystem / before_subsystem - 1),
        'model_us': [
            event(baseline, 'optimized_transformer')['self_device_time_us'],
            event(current, 'optimized_transformer')['self_device_time_us'],
        ],
    }
    profiles[name]['model_delta_pct'] = 100 * (
        profiles[name]['model_us'][1] / profiles[name]['model_us'][0] - 1
    )
baseline_profiles = [
    load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-baseline-row09-profile.json'),
    load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-baseline-row09-profile-recheck.json'),
]
current_profiles = [
    load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row09-profile.json'),
    load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row09-profile-confirmation.json'),
]
def row9_values(payload):
    add = optional(payload, 'aten::add')
    fused = optional(payload, '_residual_layer_norm_fwd')
    norm = event(payload, 'aten::native_layer_norm')
    return {
        'model_us': event(payload, 'optimized_transformer')['self_device_time_us'],
        'subsystem_us': (
            (add or {'self_device_time_us': 0})['self_device_time_us']
            + (fused or {'self_device_time_us': 0})['self_device_time_us']
            + norm['self_device_time_us']
        ),
        'fused_count': 0 if fused is None else fused['count'],
        'native_count': norm['count'],
    }
row9_before = [row9_values(payload) for payload in baseline_profiles]
row9_after = [row9_values(payload) for payload in current_profiles]
bsub = statistics.mean(item['subsystem_us'] for item in row9_before)
asub = statistics.mean(item['subsystem_us'] for item in row9_after)
bmodel = statistics.mean(item['model_us'] for item in row9_before)
amodel = statistics.mean(item['model_us'] for item in row9_after)
profiles['row9'] = {
    'before': row9_before,
    'after': row9_after,
    'subsystem_mean_us': [bsub, asub],
    'subsystem_delta_pct': 100 * (asub / bsub - 1),
    'model_mean_us': [bmodel, amodel],
    'model_delta_pct': 100 * (amodel / bmodel - 1),
}
heldout_names = [
    'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-heldout-5seed.json',
    'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-heldout-5seed-confirmation.json',
    'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-heldout-recheck-a.json',
    'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-heldout-recheck-b.json',
]
heldout = []
for name in heldout_names:
    payload = load(name)
    by_case = {item['case_id']: item for item in payload['results']}
    heldout.append(
        {
            'file': name,
            'geomean': statistics.geometric_mean(
                item['timing']['speedup_median'] for item in payload['results']
            ),
            'long_causal': by_case['long-causal']['timing']['speedup_median'],
            'long_causal_padding': by_case['long-causal-padding']['timing']['speedup_median'],
        }
    )
long_names = {
    'row5': 'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row05-long.json',
    'row6': 'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row06-long.json',
    'row9': 'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row09-long.json',
    'row11': 'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-row11-long.json',
    'long_causal': 'rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-long-causal-long.json',
}
longs = {}
for name, path in long_names.items():
    result = load(path)['results'][0]
    longs[name] = {
        'baseline_ms': result['timing']['baseline']['median_ms'],
        'optimized_ms': result['timing']['optimized']['median_ms'],
        'speedup': result['timing']['speedup_median'],
        'failed': sum(trial['failed_elements'] for trial in result['accuracy']['trials']),
        'peak_bytes': result['peak_memory']['optimized']['incremental_peak_bytes'],
        'backends': result['timing']['backend_counts'],
    }
final_primary = load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-final.json')
final_confirmation = load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-final-confirmation.json')
organizer = load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-organizer-default.json')
source = load('rtx-5070-ti-2026-08-29-c11-integrated-source-derived.json')
output = {
    'fingerprint': final_primary['environment']['git']['implementation_sha256'],
    'final': {
        'primary_geomean': final_primary['summary']['geometric_mean_speedup'],
        'confirmation_geomean': final_confirmation['summary']['geometric_mean_speedup'],
        'primary_rows': {
            item['case_id']: item['parsed'].get('speedup_median')
            for item in final_primary['results']
            if item['status'] == 'PASS'
        },
        'failed_elements': final_primary['summary']['total_failed_elements'],
        'compared_elements': final_primary['summary']['total_compared_elements'],
        'backends': final_primary['summary']['attention_backend_counts'],
    },
    'organizer_default_speedup': organizer['parsed']['speedup_median'],
    'source_geomean': source['summary']['geometric_mean_speedup'],
    'heldout': heldout,
    'longs': longs,
    'profiles': profiles,
}
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
assert output['fingerprint'] == '9c326536ea27cfc619f01531152b2c82986d9dc3f4274691d3e8191bbb0804eb'
assert output['final']['failed_elements'] == 0
assert profiles['row9']['subsystem_delta_pct'] < -40
